laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The separable particle 'op' belongs at the end of the clause; placing the adjunct after it is a spoken-style construction.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing a prepositional phrase after the separable particle is normal written Afrikaans, and ending on 'met turbines' reads naturally, so the reorder is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'vis te vang' is the natural infinitive; 'te visvang' sounds forced.
